scenarios.title: Stealth blackout via protocol whitelisting
scenarios.basis: IR-2025-06 / IR-2026-01: middleboxes rather than BGP; DNS/80/443 only; DNS poisoning; VPNs failing
scenarios.mechanism: Middlebox / stealth (BGP still visible) - matches the documented Iran 2025-26 pattern (IODA, Project Ainita)

scenarios.title: Regional blackout, AS-level view
scenarios.basis: ET-2026-09 (ChatVE brief): Ethio Telecom and Safaricom down at about 22:21 on 24 Sep 2026 after an offensive was declared and airports were seized
scenarios.mechanism: Middlebox / stealth (BGP still visible) - the real cut mechanism is not established in the sources; this trace keeps BGP visible

scenarios.title: Same event in the national aggregate
scenarios.basis: ET-2026-09: national connectivity fell only to about 82%, so the regional blackout is hidden in national data

scenarios.title: Bandwidth throttling during protests
scenarios.basis: KE-2024-06: NetBlocks recorded a sharp drop in traffic from about 16:00 on 25 Jun 2024; X hard to reach; operators blamed undersea cables

scenarios.title: Targeted slowdowns and selective blocking
scenarios.basis: TG-2025-06: ISOC Togo Chapter recorded 1,072 anomalies; DNS/IP filtering; YouTube blocked

scenarios.title: Platform throttling and VPN targeting
scenarios.basis: RU-2024-YT / RU-2026-02 / RU-2025-08: YouTube and Telegram slowed; calls blocked; push toward MAX

scenarios.title: Platform ban (X) with VPN pressure
scenarios.basis: PK-2024-02: X blocked 17 Feb 2024 - 7 May 2025 after election-fraud claims; VPN licensing

scenarios.title: Election-day blackout, then platform blocks
scenarios.basis: TZ-2025-10: blackout from 29 Oct 2025 with partial restoration on 3 Nov; social media still restricted
scenarios.mechanism: Middlebox / stealth (BGP still visible) - the real cut mechanism is not established in the sources; this trace keeps BGP visible
